payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and explanation of Masked Document Generation (MDG), detailing its process and rationale.

claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) involves recovering a document with a masked span of tokens, where a span is randomly selected and masked instead of using a [MASK] token.
MDG is one of the tasks used during pre-training, alongside other tasks, with each task being randomly selected for training.
